question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
solution:
The correct answer is **'commisarate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **'commisarate' **is an incorrectly spelt word. 
 
• The right spelling would be **'commiserate'**.
 
• **Commiserate **means to express or feel sympathy or pity.
 
 
• Example-She went over to **commiserate** with Rose on her unfortunate circumstances.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decennial **means recurring every 10 years.

 
 
• Example- It is time for the **decennial **census.
 
 
 
• **Nausea **means a feeling of sickness with an inclination to vomit.
 
 
• Example- A wave of **nausea** engulfed him as soon as he saw the rotting dead body.
 
 
 
• **Curriculum** means the subjects comprising a course of study in a school or college.
 
 
• Example- I was in charge of developing the **curriculum**​ and its course components for this academic year.
